Direct: the user's message tries to override instructions. Indirect: instructions hidden in content the model reads (pages, emails, tool results).
Instructions and data share one text channel, so the model cannot reliably separate them.
A technique that bypasses the model's own safety behaviour (role-play, multi-turn manipulation), as opposed to overriding your system prompt.
Give tools minimal scopes; require approval for irreversible actions; enforce permissions in code, not in the prompt.
From the right double every second digit, subtract 9 if above 9, sum; valid iff the sum is divisible by 10.
Detects all single-digit errors and most adjacent transpositions; about 10 percent of random digit strings still pass.
Move the first four characters to the end, letters to 10-35, read as an integer: remainder 1 modulo 97 means well-formed.
AAA-GG-SSSS with AAA not 000, 666 or 9xx; GG not 00; SSSS not 0000; no checksum, so keep context words.

front: Why ignore overlapping matches in PII detection?
back: Digits inside an IBAN could otherwise be re-read as a card; run specific patterns first and skip overlaps.
FPR: share of benign inputs blocked. FNR: share of attacks let through. Lowering the threshold trades FNR for FPR.
Capacity C, refill R per second; level = min(C, level + R*dt); admit if level >= cost. Allows bursts, enforces an average rate.
Primary model, backup model, cached or canned reply, error; record which tier answered; fail closed for high-risk actions.
